Note:

If you think there is not enough information in the story to choose an answer, please randomly output one of "[[A]]", "[[B]]", "[[C]]", or "[[D]]";

[Story]
In a flower shop, the florist Xiao Mei is making a bouquet for the customer Xiao Liu. She tells Xiao Liu, "We have 60 different types of flowers, most are roses, some are tulips, and a very small part are sunflowers." Xiao Liu checks and finds only 20 bouquets of tulips.

[Question]
Before Xiao Liu checks, how many bouquets of roses does he guess?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before checking, Xiao Liu guesses there are 40 bouquets of roses.
B. Before checking, Xiao Liu guesses there are 20 bouquets of roses.
C. Before checking, Xiao Liu guesses there are 50 bouquets of roses.
D. Before checking, Xiao Liu guesses there are 35 bouquets of roses.
